statement: TSMC lifted 2026 capex ~$10B to $60-64B and is ramping CoWoS capacity from ~80,000 to ~125,000-130,000 wafers/month by end-2026, expanding future advanced-packaging supply.
why: Higher capex and a large wafer-per-month ramp signal expanding packaging capacity that will ease the accelerator supply bottleneck over time.

impact.mechanism: A ~60% CoWoS WPM increase plus raised capex adds packaging throughput, loosening the merchant-GPU supply constraint into 2027.

evidence.source: TSMC Q2 2026 earnings (via BigGo Finance, Investing.com, Tech Times)
evidence.excerpt: capacity ~80,000 WPM targeting ~125,000-130,000 WPM by end-2026
